item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 15, 2026
item.description: A fresh, wide view could be hard to handle today. With the emotional Moon entering Aquarius at 1:17 am EST, we may feel pulled toward community conversations that spark inventive ideas and build kinder bonds. That said, changing the status quo often requires letting go of dynamics we find comfortable. When Luna conjoins intense Pluto, our feelings about such shifts might burst out in unpleasant ways! There’s more to life than logic, but overwrought emotions are likely to pass if we let them.

item.title: Larry Rubama: ODU basketball legend Ronnie Valentine is welcomed back by Hampton Roads greats
item.description: The Monarchs retired the No. 42 jersey of their all-time leading scorer on Saturday, but first he was honored with a pre-jersey celebration with former players and fans on Friday. Valentine went through hard times for nearly three decades in Miami.
